name: Mesu Ochi! Kyonyuu Mizugizuma-tachi to no Love Ero Swimming! ~Pool de Kanshiin no Baito o Hajimetara Mizugi no Hitozuma-tachi ni Kakomarete Doutei Soushitsushita!?~
original_name: メス堕ち！巨乳水着妻達とのラブエロスイミング！～プールで監視員のバイトを始めたら水着の人妻達に囲まれて童貞喪失した!?～
source: The protagonist is an ordinary college student. During the summer vacation, he is asked by his childhood friend's older sister, Misato, to work part-time at a swimming school. He gets to know the office lady Riku who is a customer, and the housewife Nanami who attends the school. The protagonist becomes close with them. Although he knows it's wrong because they are married women, he can't resist the attractive breasts wrapped in swimsuits and his own lust, and they become emotionally and physically intimate.
translation: 主角是一名普通的大学生。暑假期间，青梅竹马的姐姐美里邀请他去游泳学校打工。他结识了作为顾客的办公室女士Riku和就读学校的家庭主妇七海。主角与他们变得亲密。尽管他知道这是错误的，因为他们是已婚妇女，但他无法抗拒泳衣包裹的诱人乳房和自己的欲望，他们在情感和身体上变得亲密。
